svg.title: Software Engineering Syllabus Mind Map
svg.desc: A mind map showing all topics from the Gate Smashers software engineering syllabus discussion, branching from a central SDLC node.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me a detailed note on Software Engineering as a discipline')
sendPrompt('Generate a note on the Introduction to Software Engineering')
sendPrompt('What is the definition of software engineering?')
sendPrompt('What are the advantages and disadvantages of software engineering?')
sendPrompt('Generate a detailed note on the Software Development Life Cycle SDLC')
sendPrompt('Explain SDLC models: Waterfall, Incremental, Prototype, Spiral')
sendPrompt('Explain the Waterfall model in detail')
sendPrompt('Explain Prototype and Spiral models')
sendPrompt('Generate a note on Requirement Analysis in software engineering')
sendPrompt('What is an SRS document and how is it structured?')
sendPrompt('Generate a note on Software Project Management')
sendPrompt('Explain the COCOMO model with examples')
sendPrompt('What are Lines of Code and Function Points in software estimation?')
sendPrompt('Generate a note on Software Design including coupling and cohesion')
sendPrompt('Explain coupling and cohesion with examples')
sendPrompt('What are UML diagrams and DFDs used for in software design?')
sendPrompt('Generate a note on Software Testing: white-box, black-box, unit, integration, system')
sendPrompt('Explain white-box and black-box testing')
sendPrompt('What is unit, integration, and system testing?')
sendPrompt('Generate a note on Software Maintenance')
sendPrompt('What types of software maintenance exist?')
sendPrompt('Explain Quality Management and Reusability in software engineering')
sendPrompt('What is ISO certification and quality assurance in software?')
